environment.description: Service deployed on ECS Fargate in us-east-1 VPC (vpc-0xdeadbeef). The task ENI is in private subnets (10.200.64.0/19, 10.200.96.0/19) with no NAT gateway or IGW route. Traffic is served exclusively through a VPC Endpoint Service (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-04f7a8b3c2e1d9f06) backed by a Network Load Balancer (internal scheme). Consumer access requires explicit principal allowlisting in the VPC endpoint service's allowed-principals list (restricted to arn:aws:iam::111222333444:root and arn:aws:iam::555666777888:root). The NLB target group performs health checks on /health. Security group sg-0f9e8d7c on the ECS task allows inbound TCP/8080 only from the NLB's private IPs (10.200.64.10, 10.200.96.10). There is no public DNS record, no internet gateway in the VPC route tables, and the VPC has no peering connections to any VPC with internet egress. The endpoint service has 'Acceptance Required' set to true, meaning new endpoint connection requests must be manually approved.
